notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of mana-producing artifact(s) that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {R}{R}.
You control at least three additional nontoken artifacts, including the mana-producing artifact(s).
description:
Activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any artifact except itself, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 2 for each remaining applicable artifact.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing itself, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Scrap Mastery by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing each player to exile all artifact cards from your graveyard, then sacrifice all artifacts they control, then return all exiled cards from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 1-4 one additional time.
Activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Scrap Mastery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.
If artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana of those types.
If you control four or more other nontoken artifacts as this combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
